Definition: from a compound of G3641 and ὤρα ("care"); to have little regard for, i.e. to disesteem:--despise.
BiblicalUsage: Oligoreo means to have little regard for, to despise, to think lightly of. It occurs once, in Hebrews 12:5, where the exhortation says, My son, despise not thou the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when thou art rebuked of him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the chastening of the Lord is the proof of sonship, and despising it is refusing the Father's love.
